premise: The whole crew crowds the greenhouse for something smaller than a thumbnail: the seedling's first new leaf, under the grow-light the solar panel powers.
inspiration: Jack and the Beanstalk, turned: the giant thing that grows is one small leaf, and it is enough.
learning: Plants can grow on the Moon inside a sealed greenhouse, under grow-lights.

en-US.title: The First Leaf
en-US.text: {seedling:enter} In its little glass dome, the seedling had two leaves, and a third one curled up tight, {seedling:pulse} waiting. {engineer:enter} Engineer had a plan, a cable and a {solar-panel:enter} solar panel. She turned the panel {solar-panel:live} to face the Sun, and ran the cable into the {greenhouse:enter} greenhouse. {sfx:click} Click — the grow-lights {greenhouse:live} glowed a soft violet. Plants can grow on the Moon, inside a sealed dome, under lights like these. {seedling:live hold} The seedling reached up toward them. {engineer:face happy} And slowly, slowly, the curled-up leaf began to open. [whispers] Everyone came to look. {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face surprised} Astronaut pressed her visor to the glass. The leaf was smaller than a thumbnail. {engineer:face surprised} {engineer:hop} [excited] It's opening! {all:face happy} {all:sparkle} It was the biggest thing that had ever happened on the Moon.

es-ES.title: La primera hoja
es-ES.text: {seedling:enter} En su cúpula de cristal, el brote tenía dos hojas, y una tercera enrollada, {seedling:pulse} esperando. {engineer:enter} Ingeniera tenía un plan, un cable y un {solar-panel:enter} panel solar. Giró el panel {solar-panel:live} hacia el Sol y llevó el cable hasta el {greenhouse:enter} invernadero. {sfx:click} Clic: las luces de cultivo {greenhouse:live} se encendieron, de un violeta suave. En la Luna las plantas pueden crecer dentro de una cúpula cerrada, con luces como estas. {seedling:live hold} El brote se estiró hacia ellas. {engineer:face happy} Y despacito, despacito, la hoja enrollada empezó a abrirse. [whispers] Todos vinieron a mirar. {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face surprised} Astronauta pegó el visor al cristal. La hoja era más pequeña que una uña. {engineer:face surprised} {engineer:hop} [excited] ¡Se está abriendo! {all:face happy} {all:sparkle} Era lo más grande que había pasado nunca en la Luna.
